item.title: Postal 0.2.2657
item.description:
• Pasting a subject finds the email
  • See your past searches
  • Press / to edit your search
  • Drag tabs to put them in your order
  • Add pictures to your feedback
  • Long searches find the exact email first
  • Scroll bars stay out of your way
  • Search starts with your exact words
  • Sent is in Gmail's order
  • Layout has its own place in Settings
  • Tab switches search tabs as you type
  • See when an email came, at a glance
  • Resize floating search from any corner
  • Make your email list look like Gmail
  • See file names under emails in Gmail style
  • Finishing a word keeps your search results
  • Search shows your newest emails first
  • Search tabs stay after you press Return
  • Switches that are on now look on
  • Settings is simpler, and you can search it
  • Shift+Tab brings a sub-bullet back out
  • Search opens the way you pick
  • Search results no longer keep you waiting
  • Typing in a reply no longer stalls
